title: Unique forms of continuity in space

said.q: In this powerful sculpture, he attempts to capture the speed and movement of a human figure in a single sculpture. Structure of the action He is interested not only in the depiction of the many stages and moments of a hurrying figure, but also above all in the idea of the movement of a figure in space. ‘Not a unique form, but a unique sculptural rhythm, not the structure of the body, but the structure of the body’s action.’
